column10: A stand-up briefing starts with the conclusion (done, late, or a question)
Write delays in days, with one line for the reason and one for the next step
Agents never write "the gap is filled". They list the gaps; a person confirms them
A chat reply states its point in the first line, and says plainly what is not done
